ir.label: Iran
ir.note: Requests are sent from our server inside Iran, and the callback address is inside Iran too.

intl.label: Outside Iran
intl.note: Requests are sent from our international server.

unknown.label: I don't know
unknown.note: We use the default settings. If checks are slow or cannot reach the site, specify this.

noExec.label: exec() is disabled
noExec.effect: Backups cannot use mysqldump; we use the pure-PHP path instead, which is slower but works everywhere.

lowMemory.label: Low PHP memory
lowMemory.effect: File backups and full scans may stop halfway. We split the work into smaller chunks.

pageCache.label: Server-level page cache
pageCache.effect: The speed check may never reach PHP, leaving no queries to count — which is good news in itself, but the report comes back empty.

readonlyCore.label: Read-only core files
readonlyCore.effect: Core updates are not done from our panel; the host manages them.

cdn.label: CDN in front of the site
cdn.effect: Health and conflict checks may get a cached response, so we add a unique parameter to the URLs.

notes.noKnownLimits: We have no known limitations recorded for this host — that means we have not seen any, not that there definitely are none.
notes.notListed: This host is not on our list, so no special behaviour is configured for it.
